thread:
lee: Quick heads-up — planning a short quiet window in ~12m to roll a tiny runtime header change that touches router matching and console validation. need pin + flag coordination.

harper: window length? and which services need to be pinned?

lee: 25m window, start 176999,9900 (ish). canary plan: 4% (8m) -> 25% (8m) -> 100%. runtime will be pinned to `runtime-k-2026-03` for waves. router gets `hdr-compat` shim. console must stay on previous artifact until flag flip.

morgan: tagging @morgan: i'll own the console flag flip. we'll ship `ui.hdr_v2` OFF; flip to staged at 25% success.

oncall: Preflight checks for oncall: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/runtime`, `kubectl get pods -l service=router -n prod`, and `curl -fsS https://api.internal/health`. Also monitor `router.latency.p95` and `runtime.errors.5xx`.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by request: canary start 1769999900 -> 4% traffic. Plan: canary(4%) -> monitor(8m) -> expand(25%) -> monitor(8m) -> full. Auto-rollback hooks configured.

oncall: Rollback thresholds (short): p95 +180ms vs baseline, 5xx rate +0.5% absolute, gateway 502/504 jump >0.25%, or console header-parse warnings >1% of requests. If hit -> abort and revert runtime+router.

harper: also make sure API accepts both header shapes during a 10m soft-fallback after 100% before we hard-cut v1. i will ping integrators channel.

morgan: console harness will run in canary and 25% stages and post quick summaries here. i'll flip the flag only after harness <0.8% warnings.

devops-bot: Canary launched at 1769999900 -> 4% traffic. Monitoring hooks live.

oncall: 1770000500: 8m at 4% stable; p95 +7ms, 5xx flat. promoting to 25%.

morgan: console harness: 0.35% header-parse warnings in canary logs (below threshold). prepping staged flag at 25% now.

harper: unpin console artifact only after flag confirmed staged. remember to remove auto-deploy hooks for console during window.

oncall: 1770000591: 25% stage stable for 8m; metrics nominal. proceeding to 100%. no rollback signals.

devops-bot: Gradewave to 100% started.

harper: flipping `ui.hdr_v2` to staged then 100% as soon as 25% monitor clears.

morgan: will push the release note draft to the doc after finalize: https://go/release-notes/1769999 (internal).

lee: standing by as release owner. ping here with any anomalies; rollback instructions in the runbook. :thumbsup:
